MEASURED: the same fund shows the SAME MC in two satellites (GLD 147.7 at weight 8.34 in Opal Satellite 15 and 147.7 at weight 2.11 in Opal Satellite 80) -- correct for a fund-level fact, and also the tell that nothing on the row scales with the position. The double grain is NOT new (the pre-edit Models dump shows the same seven columns beside the same WEIGHT column); what is new is a Black Diamond position row and a Yang fund fact in one line. The header word that would settle it is in this file and was NOT changed, because the TO names four hunks and a column-group rename is not one of them. READING 2, one glyph for two silences. The table renders '-' both for 'no source carries this measure' (CASH's every cell; GLD's yield/duration/credit/beta) and for 'the column does not apply to this class' (Duration on Equity at :1576, Beta on Fixed Income at :1590). MEASURED by w25_dash_census.py, which files a cell under BOTH when the rule and a served null are both true rather than guessing a cause: Opal Satellite 15 34 dash cells of 112 -- CLASS RULE ONLY 0, ABSENT MEASURE ONLY 19, BOTH (inseparable on screen) 15; Opal Satellite 80 40 of 112 -- 0 / 26 / 14. SO ON TODAY'S PAYLOAD NOT ONE DASH IS THE CLASS RULE ALONE: the ambiguity is structural and LATENT, and becomes visible the first day a producer serves a duration for an Equity ticker. A FOURTH glyph sits in the same table: the performance cells use an EM DASH for a null -- 9 of 128 cells in Satellite 15 and 10 of 128 in Satellite 80 (CASH's eight windows each, plus PFDE's 1Y and, in Satellite 80, PFOE's 1Y, all served null). And the ACTIVE column now has THREE states because this TO SPENT A GLYPH rather than overloading one (2 of 32 rows moved from a false 'NO' to '-'), which is the same choice this reading asks about for Duration and Beta, decided the other way in the same file. NO VERDICT OFFERED.
